name: Lexus IS 500 F Sport Performance
h1: Lexus IS 500 F Sport Performance: performance, engine and what owners say

nhtsa.note: NHTSA has no separate IS 500 name in its complaint files. IS 500 owners file under IS, which also covers the IS 300 and IS 350, so these counts include those versions.

gens.tag: The IS with the 472 hp V8; rear-drive, 8-speed automatic, Torsen limited-slip differential.

variants.name: IS 500 F Sport Performance
variants.what: Standard Dynamic Handling Package: adaptive suspension, Torsen limited-slip differential, 14.0-inch front brake rotors.

2UR-GSE.name: Lexus 2UR-GSE
facts: Titanium intake and exhaust valves, forged connecting rods

issues.x: NHTSA recall 26V-222 covers 2015–2022 Lexus RC, 2016–2020 GS and 2022 IS vehicles: the low-pressure fuel pump in the tank may fail, which can stall the engine.
issues.fix: Dealer replaces the fuel pump for free (NHTSA 26V-222). Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.
